author: petr1petr
body:
go to database and check what he does: [https://codex.fqegg.top/#/codex/bosses/griffin/](https://codex.fqegg.top/#/codex/bosses/griffin/)

wearing item with dragon element (shield, boots, armor, helm) will help you reduce his dmg.

he is weak to lighning, so using lightning skills will deal more dmg. 

it will get better and better as you lvl up :)
